, X.BUYER_CODE /* 히든필드 */ , X.AGENT_CODE /* 히든필드 */ , X.WAREHOUSE_CODE /* 히든필드 */ , X.INV_NO /* 히든필드 */ , X.INV_SEQ /* 히든필드 */ , X.CONTRACT_NO /* 히든필드 */ , X.CONTRACT_SEQ /* 히든필드 */ FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME , A.BEFORE_GR_DATE AS BEFORE_GR_DATE , A.PO_NO AS PO_NO , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION , A.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME , A.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , A.ITEM_QTY , A.REQ_USER_NAME , A.REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , A.REQ_USER_TEL_NO , A.AGENT_NAME , A.AGENT_USER_NAME , A.AGENT_TEL_NO , A.KEP_USER_NAME , A.SPECIFICATION , A.ORIGIN_NAME , A.AGENT_PRICE , A.UNIT_MEASURE , A.BS_NO , A.BUYER AS BUYER_CODE , A.CLOSE_ITEM_QTY , A.DELIVERY_FLAG , A.PROCESS_TYPE , A.DELY_TO_LOCATION , A.REQ_USER_ID , A.REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE , A.MAKER_CODE , A.ORIGIN_CODE , A.AGENT_CODE , A.AGENT_USER_ID , A.KEP_USER_ID , CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'D' THEN 'BS99' /* 선입고취소 */ WHEN A.DELIVERY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'BS40' /* 납품확정 */ WHEN A.DELIVERY_FLAG = 'P' THEN 'BS30' /* 납품예정 */ WHEN B.INV_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'BS20' /* 입고예정 */ WHEN B.INV_NO IS NULL THEN 'BS10' /* 요청 */ ELSE NULL END AS STATUS , DECODE(B.WMS_IVK_QTY, 0, '출고예정', '출고') AS STATUS_TEXT , DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','TR','1','재고','3','VMI') AS PROCESS_TEXT , B.ADD_DATE , B.WMS_GR_DATE , B.INV_QTY , B.WMS_GR_QTY , CASE WHEN B.SCHEDULED_DATE IS NULL OR B.SCHEDULED_DATE = '' THEN TO_CHAR( ( CASE WHEN (SYSDATE+7)-NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE,1)+1 = 6 THEN SYSDATE+3 WHEN (SYSDATE+7)-NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE,1)+1 = 7 THEN SYSDATE+2 ELSE SYSDATE+1 END ), 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE B.SCHEDULED_DATE END SCHEDULED_DATE , NVL(C.CAR_ID,'') CAR_ID , NVL(C.CAR_NO,'') CAR_NO , NVL(C.CAR_PERSON_NAME,'') CAR_PERSON_NAME , NVL(C.CAR_PERSON_TEL,'') CAR_PERSON_TEL , CASE WHEN B.BOX_QTY IS NULL OR B.BOX_QTY = 0 THEN 1 ELSE B.BOX_QTY END BOX_QTY , A.WAREHOUSE_CODE , B.INV_NO , B.INV_SEQ , A.CONTRACT_NO , A.CONTRACT_SEQ FROM KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_MNG A /* 선입고관리 */ , KEP_BEFORE_STOCKED_IVDT B /* 선입고송장상세 */ , ( SELECT CAR_ID , CAR_NO , CAR_PERSON_NAME , CAR_PERSON_TEL , BASE_YN , BUYER FROM BNTBUYERCARINFO WHERE BASE_YN = 'Y' ) C WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BS_NO = B.BS_NO AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER(+)
AND A.BEFORE_GR_DATE >= #{st_from_date} /* 요청일FROM */ AND A.BEFORE_GR_DATE <= #{st_to_date} /* 요청일TO */
AND A.ADD_DATE >= #{st_from_date} /* 납품일FROM */ AND A.ADD_DATE <= #{st_to_date} /* 납품일TO */
AND A.BUYER IN
#{item}
AND A.AGENT_CODE = #{st_agent_code}
AND A.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code}
AND A.BS_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_bs_no} || '%'
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_name} || '%'
AND ( ( A.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' /* TR일 경우 */ AND B.WMS_GR_QTY != 0 ) OR ( A.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('1', '3') /* 재고/VMI일 경우 */ ) )
AND A.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' /* TR일 경우 */ AND B.WMS_GR_QTY != 0
AND A.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('1', '3') /* 재고/VMI일 경우 */
AND (B.WMS_IVK_QTY = 0 OR B.WMS_IVK_QTY IS NULL) ORDER BY A.BUYER , A.BS_NO DESC ) X
